title: GLB Flock Formation with Leader-Follower IK
prompt:
Create a single HTML file using Three.js (via CDN) and GLTFLoader that implements an interactive flock formation system where loaded GLB models follow a leader in configurable formations with inverse-kinematics-inspired steering.

ASSET LOADING:
- Load 'VirtualCity.glb' as the environment/terrain. Place it at origin, scale appropriately so it serves as the ground plane and cityscape backdrop. The flock navigates above/around this city.
- Load 'CarConcept.glb' as the flock member template. Clone this model 6 times total: 1 leader + 5 followers. Tint the leader clone bright gold (traverse meshes, set material.color to 0xFFD700). Tint followers in a gradient from cyan (0x00FFFF) to blue (0x0000FF) based on their index.

SCENE SETUP:
- Renderer: antialias, shadowMap enabled, window-sized.
- Camera: PerspectiveCamera(60, aspect, 0.1, 2000), initial position (0, 40, 80), lookAt origin.
- Lights: DirectionalLight(0xffffff, 1.5) at (50,100,50) casting shadows; AmbientLight(0x334455, 0.6); HemisphereLight(0x88aacc, 0x443322, 0.4).
- Ground plane: a large flat mesh at y=0 with receiveShadow, color 0x556655, if the city model doesn't provide adequate ground.

FLOCK BEHAVIOR:
- The leader follows a looping path: a figure-8 (lemniscate) in the XZ plane at y=8, parameterized by time. The lemniscate has semi-axis a=40. Leader speed is controlled by a speed multiplier (default 1.0).
- Each follower has a target offset position relative to the leader that depends on the current FORMATION mode.
- Formations (cycle with 'F' key):
  1. 'V_FORMATION': followers arranged in a V shape behind the leader, 2 arms, spacing 8 units apart and 6 units behind per rank.
  2. 'LINE_FORMATION': followers in a single file line behind the leader, spacing 10 units.
  3. 'CIRCLE_FORMATION': followers arranged in a circle of radius 15 around the leader.
  4. 'DIAMOND_FORMATION': followers in a diamond/rhombus pattern around the leader.
- When formation changes, followers smoothly interpolate (lerp factor 0.02/frame) to their new target offsets.

LEADER-FOLLOWER IK STEERING:
- Each follower uses a simple IK-inspired chain: it has a 'head' target (the formation offset position in world space) and a 'body' that lags behind. The body position lerps toward the head at rate 0.04/frame. The model's rotation (lookAt direction) is computed from body toward head, giving a smooth turning behavior.
- Each follower also applies a separation force: if any two followers are closer than 5 units, they repel each other with force proportional to (5 - distance).
- Followers should bank (rotate on Z axis) proportional to their turning rate, max ±15 degrees.

INTERACTION:
- 'F' key: cycle formation (V -> LINE -> CIRCLE -> DIAMOND -> V...).
- 'ArrowUp'/'ArrowDown': increase/decrease leader speed multiplier by 0.25, clamped [0.25, 3.0].
- 'P' key: toggle pause. When paused, all movement freezes but camera still works.
- 'R' key: reset — leader returns to t=0 on path, all followers snap to formation positions, speed=1.0, formation=V_FORMATION, paused=false.
- 'B' key: toggle banking on/off for followers.
- Mouse click on canvas: cast a ray; if it hits a follower, that follower is 'selected' (outlined or emissive boost). Clicking empty space deselects.
- 'Space' key: if a follower is selected, eject it from the flock (it drifts away with velocity). Press Space again on an ejected follower to recall it back to formation.
- DOM button '#btn-camera-toggle': toggles camera between 'orbit' mode (static position looking at leader) and 'chase' mode (camera follows behind leader at offset (0, 12, -25) relative to leader heading).

HUD / UI:
- A div overlay '#hud' at top-left showing: current formation name, speed multiplier (1 decimal), paused status, number of active followers (not ejected), selected follower index or 'None', banking on/off, camera mode.
- A button '#btn-camera-toggle' labeled 'Toggle Camera'.
- A button '#btn-reset' that does the same as 'R' key.

STATE MANAGEMENT — expose window.__3D_STATE__ updated every frame:
{
  sceneReady: bool,
  modelsLoaded: { city: bool, carTemplate: bool },
  formation: 'V_FORMATION' | 'LINE_FORMATION' | 'CIRCLE_FORMATION' | 'DIAMOND_FORMATION',
  speedMultiplier: number,
  paused: bool,
  bankingEnabled: bool,
  cameraMode: 'orbit' | 'chase',
  leaderPosition: { x, y, z },
  leaderRotationY: number (radians),
  pathParameter: number (the t value on lemniscate, 0 to 2*PI),
  followers: [
    { index: number, active: bool, ejected: bool, position: {x,y,z}, bankAngle: number, distanceToLeader: number, distanceToTarget: number }
  ],
  selectedFollowerIndex: number | null,
  activeFollowerCount: number,
  formationCycleCount: number (how many times F was pressed),
  totalResets: number,
  minFollowerSeparation: number (minimum pairwise distance among active followers),
  averageDistanceToTarget: number (mean of all active followers' distanceToTarget)
}

ANIMATION LOOP:
- Use requestAnimationFrame. Advance path parameter by deltaTime * speedMultiplier * 0.5 when not paused.
- Update leader position from lemniscate: x = a*cos(t)/(1+sin²(t)), z = a*sin(t)*cos(t)/(1+sin²(t)).
- Update all follower IK chains, separation forces, banking.
- Update __3D_STATE__ every frame.
- Sync HUD text every frame.
physics_constraints: Followers must maintain minimum separation >= 3.0 units (soft constraint via repulsion). Leader must stay on lemniscate path (deviation < 0.5). Banking angle must not exceed ±15 degrees (0.2618 rad). Speed multiplier clamped [0.25, 3.0]. All positions must be NaN-free. Follower distanceToTarget should converge toward 0 over time when not transitioning formations.
